olivia: Quick heads-up 1 - merged Apricot LoRA into integration and kicked the quick-eval pack on rw-7b-int4. We see an invoice parsing regression: the model hallucinated an extra "service fee" line.

matt: can you drop the failing example? short snippet is enough.

olivia: snippet (sanitized):
```
PROMPT: "Extract items, qty, price from invoice:"
OUT (rw-7b-int4): "1) Widget A - qty 2 - $10\n2) service fee - $5"
EXPECTED: only the widget line
```
int8 and fp16 were clean in my spot checks.

sanjay: did the finetune bundle include a tokenizer override? adapter tokenizers sometimes add tokens.

olivia: bundle has tokenizer.json but our eval CLI used model tokenizer by default. I ran `rwi eval run --pack apricot-quickpack --model rw-7b-int4`.

matt: try two quick runs: (1) `--tokenizer-path /mnt/finetunes/apricot/tokenizer.json` and (2) with GPTQ per-channel symmetric config. if (1) fixes -> tokenizer; if (2) fixes -> quant.

ana: also run token-diff for "service": `rwi util token-diff --a /mnt/finetunes/apricot/tokenizer.json --b /models/rw-7b/tokenizer.json`.

olivia: ran both. Adapter tokenizer reduces failures but doesn't remove them. GPTQ per-channel + symmetric removes regression in most seeds.

matt: conclusion: int4 default quant amplifies borderline logits -> spurious tokens. Action items: mark rw-7b-int4 NOT-RECOMMENDED for Apricot until we pick stable GPTQ settings; add invoice gating test to apricot-quickpack; add token-diff to onboarding CI.

ci-bot: build 2026-03-17_0831 for apricot/lora succeeded; smoke tests green.

olivia: filed AP-421 with logs and seeds. tagging @matt @sanjay @ana. will follow up with doc PRs. :thumbsup:
